summary: Rebuilt geography.json around a strict waking/dream split. Every Wonderland location is now layer:"dream", parented under a new organizational root (LOC-wonderland-dream) instead of a fabricated family estate, and carries a grows_from pointer to the waking-world detail it echoes (world.json wonderland_real_counterparts). LOC-hall-of-doors now has exactly one adjacency and zero spatial_relations entries, per SUP-013. The pool of tears is now the flooded hall itself (SUP-007; ch002-p07), not a separate ground-level pond. The seashore now grows from Alice's one remembered seaside trip, not a tidal Thames estuary (the Thames is not tidal at Oxford). Four new real waking-world places were registered (family house, neighbouring farm + farmyard, river backwater) plus one optional designed background landmark (distant church spire), and the hedge/burrow entry was corrected to a plain physical field-edge feature with no implied underground structure.
